response.overview: Dylan Montgomery violated his probation one too many times after losing his temper and beats a fellow pipe layer to a pulp after Dylan finds out he's been laying a lot more than pipe with Dylan's girlfriend. Dylan's mother wrangles him a one-way ticket to Los Angeles. Dylan goes out one night with his newly made construction friend Carl to a Country n' Western bar. Dylan immediately gets into hot water with the club local Kyle by dancing with Kyle's girlfriend Amanda. Bad blood between the two brews into a battle of the "tough guys". They decide to not solve their problem by beating each other to a pulp, but by the manly way of: LINEDANCING!
response.title: Lonestar Cowboy
